history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-22, before any game of this build was played (borg-zoo#692; borg-reborn-rs #1008-#1010; RULES 21). Seven arms in two worlds (14 profiles), classes-18, 18 starts
each (252 cells), 100,000 turns, evidence retained. Compare lost with lone and the others with ctl, always within a world (a world is a stress test, never a ranking).
Gate: no config_error; one binary; every cell records its world with one borg_world_data_sha256 per world across arms; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in
death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; the arms must play differently (report an arm identical to its control in all 18 games of a world; for
lost count the "(#1008)" notes). Primary: deaths by 100,000 turns; mean CL and depth may each fall by no more than 0.25 against the control in the same world. Report per world,
arm and class: deaths and causes; breeder deaths (the killer has MULTIPLY) and poison deaths; grey mushroom patch deaths apart (#969); paired rescued and newly killed against
the control (exact McNemar), identical plays; CL, depth; unfinished with denominators. Diagnostics: per game the "# Attack on sight: white worm mass (breeder)", "(lone and
slow" and "(#1008)" notes, "# Retreating to" and "# Backing up to" within 5 grids of a breeder, Hard breeder fight boosts, Phase Door reads, breeders created and killed, "# Breeders
cannot be stopped", reserve-spell casts and faints. Directional (RULES 14).
